subject: paper:horvath-2026-adhd-traits
quote: We found that higher ADHD-like traits were associated with poorer response inhibition, confirming previous research.
rationale: Direct statement of the primary result in a non-clinical sample (n = 226), replicating a hallmark finding below diagnostic thresholds.

subject: paper:horvath-2026-adhd-traits
quote: this learning advantage progressively diminished across the ADHD trait continuum, becoming markedly reduced in individuals with high symptom prevalence
rationale: The paper's core claim; backed in Results by a significant three-way interaction (No-Go performance x ASRS x Triplet Type, F(1, 13046.16) = 4.36, p = .037).

subject: paper:horvath-2026-adhd-traits
quote: a condition understood to exist along a continuum of traits in the general population
rationale: States the dimensional framing the whole design rests on — the reason a screening score is meaningful without a diagnosis.

subject: paper:horvath-2026-adhd-traits
quote: we uncovered an antagonistic relationship between inhibition and statistical learning: weaker inhibitory control was linked to enhanced learning of environmental regularities
rationale: Simple-effects analysis: learning effect b = -9.40 at low No-Go accuracy vs. b = -2.92 at high accuracy, all pairwise contrasts significant.

subject: paper:horvath-2026-adhd-traits
quote: the No-Go signal may function as a motivational magnet that triggers an automatic response
rationale: Explicitly framed by the authors as a hypothesised interpretation borrowed from animal sign-tracker research, not a measured mechanism.

subject: paper:horvath-2026-adhd-traits
quote: Another angle of interpretation emerges from research on mind wandering, the spontaneous shift of attention from external demands to internally generated thought
rationale: Offered as a secondary, transdiagnostic candidate; not measured in this study. Relevant here only because it is the closest published construct to the 'churning inside' description.

subject: paper:horvath-2026-adhd-traits
quote: our sample consisted primarily of university students, which resulted in a narrow age range and high educational attainment. While this population is common in cognitive research, it may not be fully representative of the general population.
rationale: The authors' own generalisability caveat — borrowing their continuum to place a non-student adult is an extrapolation.

subject: paper:horvath-2026-adhd-traits
quote: there was a significant gender imbalance in our sample, with 81% identifying as women ... our results should be interpreted with caution regarding their generalizability to men
rationale: Response-inhibition findings are the least sex-robust part of the result, and inhibition is exactly the axis the reshaping claim runs through.

subject: paper:horvath-2026-adhd-traits
quote: Another limitation concerns the exclusive reliance on the ASRS (Kessler et al., 2005; v1.1) for estimating ADHD-like traits. While self-report questionnaires are efficient and widely validated for dimensional studies in the general population, they may lack the precision of multi-instrument or multi-informant approaches.
rationale: The continuum is only as good as the instrument locating people on it — the same instrument this notebook's single data point comes from.
